Replaceable Dev#58: Hey there, boys and girls… And bears.

Recently there have been a lot of reports from you guys about the collectors edition default input device. We were busy with some other stuff lately but we finally got around to it. Thank you guys for the patience and support…

Amber: Ugh, this is boring stuff… Soooo boring, omg, I’m dying…

Replaceable Dev#58: Umm, but it’s the patch notes, I have to keep it short and to the point and…

Amber: You’re just the worst… Let me!

Replaceable Dev#58: (sighs)

Amber: Heeeeeey, um… You guys! 
These dorks over here fixed some boring stuff I don’t really care about… If you really want to know you can check it out below. But I on the other hand made that horsie up there, look at it! 

So cute, right? 😊


Fixes 

    Game Progress Migration
Episode 2 CE is now unlocked if standalone episode 1 has been finished, also episode 3 CE is unlocked if standalone episode 2 has been finished

    Defaulting to Gamepad
Game no longer defaults to gamepad, it defaults to keyboard and mouse. Added "Default to gamepad" setting to enable switching and defaulting to gamepad

    Achivements 
Achievements from standalone episodes are now translated to collectors edition upon next BWM CE game start

    Few Localisation Updates 
 

Not Yet Fixed 

    Save Transfer
We are working on it. It should be up soon.
 


TL;DR Fixed things, I guess… Also boring. But also horsie <3
